thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dkyus ma dang bum sgrub gnyis ka'i thun bzung dzap dgongs kyi rim pa bzhugs so/ /rang nyid thugs rje

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dkyus ma dang bum sgrub gnyis ka'i thun bzung dzap dgongs kyi rim pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300rang nyid thugs rje chen po bsgom: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: phyag g.yas pad phreng thugs kar 'dzin: phyag g.yon pad sdong bdud rtsi'i bum: rdo rje skyil krung rang 'dra'i yum: gsang ba ye shes mdangs ldan ma: mnyen lcug 'khril zhing dbyer med bsgom:

de nas phyi mdo lugs ltar bzla ba ni/ sku yi tshad ni ri rab tsam// zhal ras tshangs pa'i gnas su sleb// sngags dbyangs 'brug sgra ltar bsgrags pas// srid pa gsum dang khyad par du// 'gro drug gnas su 'ur 'ur byung*// sdug bsngal thams cad skad cig byang*// thugs rje chen po'i zhing du gyur/ dzap sgra dir dir sgrog par gyur// nang sngags kyi lugs su bzla ba ni/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ rigs drug sems can skad cig bsdus// 'jig rten gang bar 'khor du bskor// bdag nyid thugs rje chen po yi// ya rkan gnam la ma rkan sa// bar nas sngags kyi 'brug ldir bas// kun kyang bung ba tshang zhig ltar// dzap sgra dir dir bsgrags pa yis// rigs drug las dang sdul bsngal dag /thugs rje chen po'i zhing du gyur// yang gsang snying po'i lugs su bzla ba ni sgrub rkyang dang bum sgrub gnyis ka'i gtso bo yin te/ de'ang sgrub rkyang skabs/ bdag nyid thugs rje gsang ba 'dus// yab yum rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs// spyi gtsug rigs bdag sprul sku'i chas// thugs kar rta mgrin rngam brjid 'jigs// zhes pa nas/ 1$0000250bdag dang mtha' yas 1$0000300 sogs la 'jug /bum sgrub yin na/ bum pa mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// bh+rūm̐ las ye shes gzhal yas khang*// sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs// ye shes rang snang las grub pa// rgya che dpangs su mtho ba yi// nang du ril bu re re bzhin// thugs rje chen po yab yum ni// stod g.yogs ser po rin chen gyi// rgyan ldan 'od zer 'bar ba'i sku /rigs bdag ye shes sems dpar bcas// thugs srog hrīḥyis mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros nub phyogs bde chen dang*// po ta la nas ye shes pa// dpag med spyan drangs sib sib thim// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:

bdag dang mtha' yas rta mgrin gsum: thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig mthar: yig drug g.yas su bskor bar bsam: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sngags las 'od zer dkar po 'phros: rgyal ba'i sku la mnyes mchod phul: dngos grub ma lus bdag la bsdus: khams gsum sems can lus sgrib sbyangs: ma lus sdug bsngal zhi bar bsam: mtha' yas thugs ka'i sngags phreng las: 'od zer dmar po dpag med 'phros: rgyal ba'i gsung la mnyes mchod phul: gsung gi dngos grub bdag la bsdus: sems can kun gyi ngag sgrib sbyangs: kun kyang bdag gi dbang 'dus bsam: rta mgrin thugs ka'i sngags phreng las: 'od zer mthing kha rab 'phros pas: rgyal ba'i thugs la mnyes mchod phul: thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la thim: sems can kun gyi yid sgrib sbyangs: snang ba thams cad dbang bsdus bsam: phyi snod nang bcud ma lus pa: thugs rje chen po'i zhing dang sku: sgra grags yi ge bdun pa'i dbyangs: dran rtog ye shes rol par gyur: dgong thun gsham du/ dregs pa tshar gcod drag po ni/ lha gsum thugs ka'i sngags phreng las: khro chung mtshon thogs dpag med 'khrugs: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog cing*/ de sgras stong gsum yongs gang nas: bdud dang dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs: gang dag zhi bas mi thul ba: ma lus tshar bcad dag tu gyur: che btsan 'gran zla bral bar bsam: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa: ngar dang ldan pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis cung zad re bzla'o// skye bdun sgrub pa'i dmigs pa rgya can gyi sngags sham gud spros ni/ thugs srog hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros// rgyal ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams khyab// bla ma rig 'dzin sangs rgyas dang*// byang sems yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// tshe la dbang ba'i drang srong tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs ka nas// mchog thun dngos grub byin rlabs kun// bdud rtsi 'o rgyun rnam par bkug /ril bu lhar gsal spyi bor thim// sku gang yab yum sbyor mtshams nas// bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab ril bur 'dres// myang grol ye shes rdzas mchog gyur//

yig bdun sham du/ a ra pa tsa mi ta hṛ da ya swā hā: btags pas las la sbyor ba phung po sku lngar sbyar zhing tshe'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i snying po ni/ yig bdun sham du/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa ā+oṃ: a yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭha ā+oṃ: zhes gdags la tshad sogs sgrub khog tu shes par bya'o// //
